the synthesis of the halo derivatives of 1-selenadamantane and 2-selanaadamantane was performed by the reaction of bicyclnona-3, 7-diene with the corresponding selenium tetrahalide.

the reaction of bicycl[3.2.1]oct-2-en-7-one with selenium tetrafluoride and selenium tetrabromide in the presence of anhydrous aluminum chloride leads to the formation of 2-selenoadamantane derivatives with fluorine and bromine atoms in the 2-selene ring.
the reaction of bicyclona-3, 7-diene with Se2Cl2 and Se2Br2 leads to the formation of 2-seleno-2,3,6,7-tetrahaloadamantane and 2,2,3,3,6-pentahalo-7-chloroselenaadamantanes, respectively.
